title: docs(changeset): the 9242 changeset says the stray-groupBy refusal covers the list-view route only
body:
Part of #10321
Clause-②: no

Step 1 of the triage grading on objectui#10321 (comment 5820698455): the release-bound prose in `.changeset/9242-stray-kanban-groupby-lane-second-route.md`, plus the same false-coverage prose in `.changeset/8365-stray-kanban-groupby-refused.md`. The seat folded the second file in after the dev's first report; see the claim amendment on comment `5821247389` and section 4 below. Step 2 (`packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx`: its comment, and possibly a `listViews` kanban door) is not part of this PR, so #10321 remains open when this merges.

## What changed

Two files, bodies only. No code, no test, no other file.

- Both front matters are byte-identical to base (8365: lines 1-4, sha256 `558f3bc252719037` before and after). 9242's front matter (lines 1-3) is byte-identical: `cmp` of the base and head copies exits 0, and the sha256 is `844b3ecb9daa8140` before and after. `check-changeset-overwrite` prints `declared at base: @object-ui/plugin-view: minor` and `declares now: @object-ui/plugin-view: minor`.
- The dispatch named two false clauses. A third one says the same thing: the parenthetical in the "Untouched, deliberately" paragraph. All three are rewritten, and each whole paragraph was re-read afterwards.

### 1. (9242) The paragraph that opened "The affected population is narrow"

Before:

> The affected population is narrow and was measured rather than assumed: the contract half landed with PR objectui#9236 and already covers **both** routes — the view-level `KanbanConfig` mirror declares `groupBy` as a named alias refusal pointing at `groupByField`, so a view carrying the key is refused at every validating door (`os check` / `os validate`, the VS Code extension) and `tsc` refuses it at the authoring site. What remains, and what this change repairs, is a pure **behaviour** gap: a document already in storage that never passed through a validator.

After:

> The reach of the contract half was measured rather than assumed, and on this route it does not narrow the affected population: the contract half landed with PR objectui#9236 and covers the **`list-view`** route only — the view-level `KanbanConfig` mirror declares `groupBy` as a named alias refusal pointing at `groupByField`, so a `list-view` document carrying the key, under `kanban` or under the legacy `options.kanban` bag, is refused by `safeValidateSchema`. A named view's `listViews.KEY.kanban.groupBy`, the route this change repairs, gets no validating door from the contract half today: `safeValidateSchema` accepts it in either nesting and keeps the key. `tsc` refuses the declared `kanban.groupBy` at the authoring site on both routes (a named view's `kanban` is typed as the `list-view`'s), but not the key inside the untyped `options.kanban` bag on either. What this change repairs is therefore a pure **behaviour** gap, on any document that reaches this branch carrying the key, whether or not it passed through a validator.

Why the door list went: the new text names only the door the probe measured. None of the three doors in the old list runs `safeValidateSchema`, going by their source: `os` is `@objectstack/cli`, which carries no runtime import of `@object-ui/types`, and the VS Code extension imports no zod (see Acceptance notes). "Narrow" went because its only support was the both-routes claim.

### 2. The third "Level justified" bullet

Before:

> **What an author can author today is unchanged** — the key is already refused at every validating door, so no newly-authored document can legally carry it.

After:

> **What an author can author today is unchanged** — this change touches no schema: a `list-view` document carrying the key is still refused, and a named view carrying it still validates green. On that route it is this branch, which now drops the key, that keeps the lane canonical.

"Touches no schema": commit `dfe3fa48e` (PR objectui#9290) changed only this changeset, `ObjectView.tsx` and its `strayGroupByLane-9242` test.

### 3. The "Untouched, deliberately" parenthetical

Before: `the contract half (already covers both routes)`

After: ``the contract half (which covers the `list-view` route only)``

That line was re-wrapped as well: the rest of the sentence is unchanged, but its first line break moved.

### 4. `.changeset/8365-stray-kanban-groupby-refused.md` (folded in by the seat, head `f2ae93aa6`)

The same false-coverage family, publishing in the same release. Every changed sentence:

1. Headline.
   - Before: 「A stray `groupBy` in a view's kanban config no longer overrides the lane, and is now refused by name.」
   - After: 「… no longer overrides the lane, and on a `list-view` document is now refused by name.」 Only the refusal half is scoped. The lane half stays broad, because `ListView`'s destructure applies to whatever document feeds it.
2. Item 2, door list and reach.
   - Before: 「The refusal lands wherever a view's metadata is validated: the CLI's `os check` / `os validate`, the VS Code extension, and `tsc` at the authoring site」.
   - After: 「The refusal lands on the `list-view` route: wherever `safeValidateSchema` validates a `list-view` document (objectui's own `objectui validate` runs it and prints the issue), and at the authoring site, where `tsc` refuses the declared `kanban.groupBy`」.
3. Item 2, a new closing sentence: 「A named view's `listViews.KEY.kanban.groupBy` on an `object-view` document still validates green, in either nesting.」
4. Breaking, bullet 2.
   - Before: 「any pipeline running `safeValidateSchema` over it (`os check`, `os validate`, the extension) reports one issue」.
   - After: 「the same document, on the `list-view` route, now **fails validation** … (objectui's own `objectui validate` does) reports one issue」.

The door reading comes from source. `packages/cli/src/commands/validate.ts` imports `safeValidateSchema` from `@object-ui/types/zod`, calls it on the parsed file, and prints each `issue.message`. `check.ts` reads only `.success`, to classify a file, and prints no issue that names the key. So only `objectui validate` is named.

## Measured before rewriting (base `2b5f509bf`, source, not dist)

This was a one-off probe and is not committed. It ran `safeValidateSchema` and `StrictAnyComponentSchema` from `packages/types/src/zod/index.zod.ts` via `tsx`, at the repo root.

| Document | `safeValidateSchema` |
|---|---|
| `list-view`, `kanban.groupBy` | REFUSED, `invalid_type` at `kanban.groupBy` |
| `list-view`, `options.kanban.groupBy` | REFUSED, `custom` at `options.kanban.groupBy` |
| `list-view`, `kanban.groupByField` only (dark control) | accepted |
| `object-view`, `listViews.v1.kanban.groupBy` | **ACCEPTED**, `groupBy` kept in the output |
| `object-view`, `listViews.v1.options.kanban.groupBy` | **ACCEPTED**, `groupBy` kept in the output |
| `object-view`, `listViews.v1.calendar.dateField` (lit control) | REFUSED, `custom` at `listViews.v1.calendar.dateField` |
| `object-view`, `listViews.v1.options.calendar.dateField` (lit control) | REFUSED, `custom` at `listViews.v1.options.calendar.dateField` |

The probe printed `VERDICT all readings match the card`.

`tsc` result: an ad-hoc tsconfig extending `packages/types/tsconfig.examples.json` typed the literals as `ListViewSchema` and `ObjectViewSchema` from `packages/types/src/index`. It reported exactly two errors, both `TS2322: Type 'string' is not assignable to type 'undefined'`:

- `list-view` `kanban.groupBy`: refused.
- `object-view` `listViews.v1.kanban.groupBy`: refused. `NamedListView.kanban` is `ListViewSchema['kanban']`.
- Both `options.kanban.groupBy` spellings: accepted, because the bag is untyped.
- Dark control (a named view with `kanban.groupByField` only): accepted.

## Gates, all re-run at head `f2ae93aa6`

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | exit 0. "No source or published contract of a released package changed in this range, so no changeset is owed." |
| `pnpm check:changeset-claims` | exit 0. "No pending changeset names a file this change touches." The self-contradiction reading passed: "Every package declared across those 2 body(ies) is either not negated in its own prose, or negated only in an ASPECT of it". |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` | exit 0 (report-only). `0 added, 2 modified, 0 deleted`: 8365 declares `@object-ui/types: minor, @object-ui/plugin-list: minor` at base and now, and 9242 declares `@object-ui/plugin-view: minor` at base and now. Both are case 2, a deliberate correction. |
| `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals` | exit 0. "No test source names a pending changeset." |
| `pnpm changeset:check` | exit 0. All packages in the `fixed` group; no `major`. |
| `pnpm check:control-bytes` | exit 0. `OK (scanned 8390 tracked text file(s); skipped 85 binary)`. |
| `pnpm check:new-line-citations` | exit 0. `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`. |
| `node scripts/check-doc-links.mjs` | exit 0. "Links are valid across 17 scan roots." |
| `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` (both changesets) | "NOT GOVERNED — 2 path(s) checked against 5 governed surface(s); none matched." |

No type-check or test run is owed for a prose-only diff. The diff touches no package source, and the presence gate confirms that no published source moved. Repo-wide lint and CI belong to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- **The strict face is not a door for this key.** `StrictAnyComponentSchema` refuses `listViews` wholesale (`unrecognized_keys`), even for a clean named view with no stray key. Its own header says no consumer in this repository is wired to it yet, so the new text does not count it.
- **Door list (reported to the seat, then folded into this PR as section 4).**
  - The VS Code extension has zero `groupBy` or `kanban` mentions, and it imports nothing from `@object-ui/types`. The grep's lit control was `additionalProperties`, which hits. Its `SchemaValidator` says the host "imports no zod".
  - objectstack's packages carry no runtime import of `@object-ui/types`.
  - So neither the extension nor objectstack's `os` CLI runs `safeValidateSchema`. objectui's own CLI runs it in two commands, but only `objectui validate` reports the issue. `objectui check` reads `.success` only, to classify the file.
  - The pending `.changeset/8365-stray-kanban-groupby-refused.md` still lists "`os check`, `os validate`, the extension" as pipelines running `safeValidateSchema`. The seat amended the claim to cover that file, and the list is corrected in section 4.
- The behaviour half is unchanged and still holds: `generateViewSchema` destructures `groupBy: _strayGroupBy` out of the kanban config (objectui#9242), pinned by `ObjectView.strayGroupByLane-9242.test.tsx`.
